concerns.text: FR-001 requires ingesting data from Materials Project, NIST, and arXiv. Tasks T018c (Zenodo), T018d-1 (NIST), and T018e (ArXiv) are marked [ ] (incomplete) or contain empty/invalid URLs (e.,g., 'https://'). No task exists to fetch from Materials Project (FR-001 explicit requirement). The primary data ingestion requirement is unfulfilled.

SC-004 requires halting and generating a 'Data Availability Report' if N < 30. Task T017b (Implement Data Gap Validation) is marked [ ] (incomplete) and depends on T017c (Create Test Data), which is also [ ]. The pipeline cannot enforce the power limitation constraint defined in SC-004.

FR-003 mandates excluding entries with N < 30. The filtering logic is fragmented. T018f-1 (Sample Count Filter) is [ ], T018f-5 (Non-Stoichiometric) is [ ], and T059a (High-Variance Ranges) is [ ]. Without these tasks, the dataset cleaning pipeline cannot produce the required intermediate files for FR-003 compliance.

FR-008 requires appending a specific disclaimer and removing 'cause' from the conclusion. Task T043 (Generate Final Report) depends on T017b (Data Gap Report). Since T017b is incomplete, the reporting pipeline cannot deterministically generate the compliant report if the data gap condition is triggered.

FR-001 requires fetching from 'Materials Project'. No active task implements `fetch_materials_project_data`. T054-stream-test is a test task, and T065 is incomplete. The requirement to ingest from this specific repository is not mapped to a verifiable implementation task.

Tasks T018c, T018d-1, and T018e contain empty or placeholder URLs (e.g., 'https://', 'https://'). These are stale tags from an older spec/plan that do not correspond to valid, reachable sources, preventing the implementer from satisfying the fetch requirement.
Task T025 appears twice in the document (once in Phase 7, once in Phase 9). This is a duplicate entry (stale tag) that should be removed to avoid confusion.
